description: List all rim diameters (inches) available for HF tyres, optionally filtered by overall diameter and section width. Use this to discover valid rim_diameter values for search-by-hf-tire.

overall_diameter.description: Overall outside diameter of the inflated tyre in inches (e.g. 33.0 for a 33-inch tyre). Must be positive. Part of the HF size notation: OD x SW R RD (e.g. 33x12.5R15). Use list-hf-tire-overall-diameters to enumerate valid values.

region.description: Market region code (e.g. "usdm", "eudm"). Get codes from list-regions.

section_width.description: Tyre section width in INCHES (e.g. 12.5). Must be positive. Note: this differs from standard by_tire tools where section_width is in mm. Use list-hf-tire-section-widths to enumerate valid values.

name: list-hf-tire-rim-diameters
